name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, spending countless hours tinkering with engines and analyzing telemetry data. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he joined Crown Racing as a junior data analyst, quickly proving his aptitude for identifying areas for improvement in vehicle setup and driver performance. His sharp analytical mind and ability to clearly communicate complex technical information led to his promotion to test driver coordinator. Kenji is known for his meticulous approach to planning and executing test sessions, ensuring that every detail is accounted for to maximize the effectiveness of on-track evaluations.

He excels at fostering a collaborative environment between the drivers and engineering team, facilitating open communication and constructive feedback. Kenji believes that successful testing relies not only on data acquisition but also on understanding the nuances of driver feel and translating those subjective impressions into objective adjustments. His ambition is to one day lead the entire vehicle performance department, driving Crown Racing to championship glory through cutting-edge innovation and data-driven decision-making. He sees the test sessions as the bedrock of any successful racing team.

Kenji's loyalty to Crown Racing is unwavering, and his dedication to the team's success is evident in his tireless work ethic. He's a true team player, always willing to go the extra mile to support his colleagues and ensure that everyone has the resources they need to perform at their best. His innovative ideas have already contributed to several crucial breakthroughs, and he is determined to continue pushing the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks an excessive amount of green tea throughout the day.
